mapper.select:
select
, mfm.id as fee_model_id, mfm.name as fee_model_name, cu.id AS ubo_id, cu.shop_id AS shop_id, cu.auth_type, cu.id_doc_front_url, cu.id_doc_back_url, cu.address_type, cu.address_doc_url, cu.ubo_email, cu.create_time, cu.update_time, u.status, u.user_name as account_name, p.business_name as parent_business_name from shop mt left join merchant_fee_model mfm on mt.merchant_fee_model_id = mfm.id LEFT JOIN credit_ubo cu ON mt.id = cu.shop_id left join sys_user u on mt.user_id = u.user_id left join shop p on mt.parent_id = p.id where mt.parent_id = #{parentId} and mt.is_whitelist_on = #{whiteListOn} and mt.deleted = 0
